description.value: A Boston-based SaaS company that sells a customer relationship management (CRM) platform with AI agent features.
An international SaaS technology company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts; an omnichannel CRM platform with agentic AI features.
The autonomous B2C CRM and AI marketing platform that unifies customer data.
An AI marketing and customer service platform that the company describes as an 'autonomous B2C CRM'; it combines customer data with email, SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, and mobile push messaging.
Boston-based, publicly traded B2C customer data and marketing platform, founded in 2012.

product_description.value: Composer (AI marketing agent), Customer Agent (AI support agent), and the Klaviyo Marketing, Service, Analytics, and Data Platform (CDP) modules; channels include email, SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, mobile push, and social marketing.
Composer AI marketing agent; Customer Agent 24/7 customer service; Klaviyo Marketing, Service, Analytics, and Data Platform; automates email, SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, and mobile push.
Email and SMS marketing, product reviews, a customer data platform (CDP), and CRM; AI offerings include a Marketing Agent and a Customer Agent.

Email and SMS marketing, product reviews, a CDP, and CRM tools; AI offerings include a Marketing Agent and a Customer Agent; also WhatsApp, mobile push, social media marketing, customer service automation, and data management.
Customer profiles, automated workflows, a drag-and-drop email editor, and AI tools that suggest campaign text and images.

business_model_description.value: Free plan with core features; paid plans scale with the number of contacts and channel usage (such as email and SMS); enterprise pricing also available.
Free plan with core features; paid plans scale with the number of contacts and channel usage (such as email and SMS); enterprise pricing also available.
Subscription-based, with pricing tiered by number of contacts and level of service; a secondary revenue stream comes from partner agencies and service providers.

customer_description.value: Retail and ecommerce, restaurants, health and wellness, enterprises, small businesses, agencies and tech partners, and developers; powers 205,000+ brands across 100 countries.
Powering 205,000+ relationship-driven brands across 100 countries; named customers include Daily Harvest, Dollar Shave Club, Dermalogica, Hint Water, and Princess Polly.
About 196,000 merchants, most of them B2C e-commerce sellers on Shopify, WooCommerce, and PrestaShop.
Online retailers and e-commerce platforms, many of them small businesses in e-commerce and retail; over 135,000 customers at the end of Q3 2023 (earnings call).
